name: branding-seym-glass-studio-stacked-gift-boxes-with-orange-vase-shape
title: SEYM glass studio gift boxes stacked, with a flat orange vase silhouette and a high-contrast serif wordmark
whatItIs: Three off-white rigid lid boxes stacked at angles on white: the top box carries a big flat orange vase silhouette with the 'SEYM' serif wordmark crossing its neck, the others show the wordmark rotated along the lid, and each box reveals a coloured inner rim (orange, copper, navy).
whatItMeans: Crafted and gallery-like; one flat shape stands for the whole product, while coloured rims add a quiet surprise.
techniques: Reduce the product to one flat silhouette on the lid.
Let the wordmark cross the silhouette for integration.
Colour the inner tray so the rim peeks out.
Rotate the wordmark on larger boxes to vary the family.

vocabulary.definition: A solid shape showing only an outline.
